title: against 95
source: Hero might from lastasylum.gg (5 Nov 2026). Turnout from the top-100 KvK boards of 24 and 31 October and the 31 October map.
agreement: No base hits, before, during or after the fight.
lede: 95 left, 75 right. One connected block per alliance. Inside a block, slot 1 is nearest the city and goes to the strongest player who turned up for the last two KvKs. Find yourself below and the map shows your base.

items: The first ten minutes.
95 took #91's city five minutes into the fight on 31 Oct. Our first rally has to land before theirs, and the next one has to be loaded behind it.
Garrison the strongest.
Our top 20 heroes beat theirs by 4.5%. That only counts if those 20 are inside the city, so the 30 garrison places go by hero might.
Three rally groups against two.
BĐSM and DAR are their full rally groups, with CoPe behind. WPP, NEXT and HoG alternate so one is always ready.
Turrets before trading.
Turrets fire on the city. Keep NE and SE reinforced, and every turret of theirs we take stops its fire on our garrison.
Fight the whole match.
Below rank 50, 95 is deeper than us. Anyone with a march out should be hitting something until the end.
+2% attack per flag, up to five.
A flag lasts 30 minutes and has a 71.5-hour cooldown, so everyone has one flag for this match.
Waves, not all at once.
Four waves of five per alliance keep +10% running for two hours.
One stack point per alliance.
A flag reaches about three bases each way, so WPP's stack behind R3 covers all six of its wall bases. The five flags of a wave go on neighbouring tiles of the same flag row.

sections.text: Their strongest are BlueReturn꧁青色꧂ (113.3M, rsc), MadAgent007 (97.1M, DAR), r0yal666 (90.1M, BĐSM), りーも (89.0M, GETz) and Nami0 (84.1M, DAR). Since August they have taken #88's, #85's and #91's cities, all with BĐSM. Expect BĐSM first and plan the garrison against it.

The 15 bases touching the city go by the strength each alliance brought: hero might of its players who were on the 24 or 31 October board or the 31 October map. WPP 6, NEXT 4, HoG 2, ĚØN, RAE and AURA 1 each. Inside each alliance, those players come first by hero might, then everyone else.
